lines.native: ¡Hola! ¿Qué pasa? Riddle me this: why do fountains—ooh, a leaf. Just one more distraction. Five more minutes? ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Hello! What's up? Riddle me this: why do fountains—ooh, a leaf. Just one more distraction. Five more minutes? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: At The Cracked Fountain, Flick darts around the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker pops. The fountain remains unimpressed; it has seen plumbing budgets.

lines.native: Sí, miro. Pero sigo en movimiento. You got me looking, not stopping! Can you stop me with a Spanish command? Riddle me—ooh, sparks. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Yes, I’m looking. But I’m still moving. You got me looking, not stopping! Can you stop me with a Spanish command? Riddle me—ooh, sparks. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick looks. Unfortunately, it does so while orbiting your shoulder. A tiny firecracker registers its objection to sustained attention.

lines.native: ¡Vale, no me muevo! You stopped me. Attention span: suspiciously powerful. ¿Por dónde voy? Riddle me—wait, that spark has potential. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Okay, I’m not moving! You stopped me. Attention span: suspiciously powerful. Which way do I go? Riddle me—wait, that spark has potential. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker rolls past, apparently exempt from the instruction.

lines.native: Eso es inglés. Necesito una dirección en español. ¿Por dónde voy? Your compass works; its language settings don't. Riddle me—ooh, dust. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: That's English. I need a direction in Spanish. Which way do I go? Your compass works; its language settings don't. Riddle me—ooh, dust. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains just outside your gaze, where accountability cannot reach.

lines.native: ¡A la izquierda, sí! ¿Qué hora es? El reloj no funciona. Es muy pronto, seguro. Riddle me—why finish today? Wait, don't answer. Just five more minutes. Your attention span is getting unreasonable. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: To the left, yes! What time is it? The clock doesn't work. It's very early, surely. Riddle me—why finish today? Wait, don't answer. Just five more minutes. Your attention span is getting unreasonable. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick darts left, remaining firmly in the corner of your vision. A tiny firecracker pops beside the fountain’s stopped clock, which has avoided responsibility for years.

lines.native: ¡Ahora, sí! No quieres esperar. Pero falta la hora. ¿Qué hora es? El reloj no funciona. Riddle me—what has hands but zero motivation? Ooh, smoke. Your urgency gets full marks. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Now, yes! You don't want to wait. But the time is still missing. What time is it? The clock doesn't work. Riddle me—what has hands but zero motivation? Ooh, smoke. Your urgency gets full marks. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside the fountain. Flick appears at the edge of your vision; direct inspection finds only an innocent patch of air.

lines.native: ¡La una, correcto! Sabes la hora. Pero podemos esperar, ¿no? ¿Cuándo quieres hacerlo? Riddle me—why rush? Ooh, smoke. Just five more minutes. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: One o’clock, correct! You know the time. But we can wait, right? When do you want to do it? Riddle me—why rush? Ooh, smoke. Just five more minutes. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, observing none of the usual rules about corners.

lines.native: ¡Mañana, perfecto! Eso es lo que quiero. Podemos esperar. ¿Cuándo quieres hacerlo de verdad? Riddle me—ooh, smoke. Just five more minutes. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Tomorrow, perfect! That's what I want. We can wait. When do you really want to do it? Riddle me—ooh, smoke. Just five more minutes. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick celebrates your agreement to postpone; resisting the delay remains unfinished, which is its preferred condition.

lines.native: ¡Ahora, sí! No mañana. Entiendo: quieres hacerlo ahora. Has ganado. Yo voy a descansar. Your attention span: unfair. Riddle me—ooh. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Now, yes! Not tomorrow. I understand: you want to do it now. You've won. I'm going to rest. Your attention span: unfair. Riddle me—ooh. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains at the edge of your vision, where consequences have difficulty finding him. For once, postponement has lost.
